record.context_brief: Schur positivity for normalized Schur seeds
record.original_question: Let Theta_{a,b} be the elliptic Hall algebra construction that sends a degree-d symmetric-function seed g_d to an operator, and write g_d^(a,b)(x;q,t) for Theta_{a,b}(g_d)(1). Let s_hat_mu be the normalized Schur seed defined by s_hat_mu(x) = (-qt)^(-iota(mu)) s_mu(x), where mu is a partition of d and iota(mu) is the statistic defined from the positive values of mu(i)-i. For every partition mu of d and every coprime pair of positive integers a and b, prove that s_hat_mu^(a,b)(x;q,t) is Schur-positive, meaning that its expansion in the Schur basis has coefficients in N[q,t]. Can this Schur positivity be explained by bigraded subrepresentations of the S_n-module of generalized diagonal harmonics?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Lambda$ denote the ring of symmetric functions over $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$, and for each $d\geq 0$ let $\Lambda_d$ denote its homogeneous degree-$d$ component. For each coprime pair of positive integers $(a,b)$, let
$$\Theta_{a,b}\colon \Lambda_d \longrightarrow \mathrm{End}(\Lambda)$$
denote the operator-valued map associated with the elliptic Hall algebra: for a "seed" $g_d\in\Lambda_d$, $\Theta_{a,b}(g_d)$ is an operator on $\Lambda$, and we define
$$g_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,t)\;:=\;\Theta_{a,b}(g_d)(1)\in\Lambda_{db}.$$
For a partition $\mu=(\mu_1\geq \mu_2\geq\cdots)$ of $d$, set
$$\iota(\mu)\;:=\;\sum_{i\geq 1}\max(\mu_i-i,\,0),$$
and define the normalized Schur seed
$$\hat s_\mu(x)\;:=\;(-qt)^{-\iota(\mu)}\,s_\mu(x)\in\Lambda_d.$$

Prove that for every partition $\mu$ of every $d\geq 1$ and every coprime pair of positive integers $(a,b)$, the symmetric function $\hat s_\mu^{(a,b)}(x;q,t)$ is Schur-positive, i.e.
$$\hat s_\mu^{(a,b)}(x;q,t)\;=\;\sum_{\lambda\vdash db} c^{(a,b)}_{\mu,\lambda}(q,t)\,s_\lambda(x)\quad\text{with}\quad c^{(a,b)}_{\mu,\lambda}(q,t)\in\mathbb{N}[q,t].$$
Furthermore, determine whether this Schur positivity admits a representation-theoretic explanation by exhibiting bigraded $\mathfrak S_n$-subrepresentations of (a suitable module of) generalized diagonal harmonics whose bigraded Frobenius characteristics realize the functions $\hat s_\mu^{(a,b)}(x;q,t)$.

artifact.status_search_result: The Schur positivity conjecture for normalized Schur seeds under the elliptic Hall algebra operators $\Theta_{a,b}$ remains open in general. Significant partial progress has been made: Blasiak–Morse–Pun–Summers (and subsequent work on Catalan functions and Demazure crystals, Inventiones 2024) established Schur positivity in important special cases (notably for Catalan functions and the dominant rectangle case), settling related conjectures of Chen–Haiman and Shimozono–Weyman, but a full proof of Schur positivity for all $\hat s_\mu^{(a,b)}$ and a representation-theoretic interpretation via generalized diagonal harmonics has not been established.
